responsibility: Defines the central intermediate-representation interface for GNU Modula-2’s front end. It declares the quadruple operator enumeration, operand-stack operations, and the large family of builders, queries, patching routines, analysis hooks, and display helpers used by parser passes to construct control flow, expressions, procedure/module boundaries, constructors, exception regions, inline asm, and compiler-mode pseudo-quads, and by later stages to inspect and transform that quad stream before GCC tree generation.
same_name_distinction: This `.def` file is the very large public contract for the quad IR, exporting the operator type and the many builders, stack operations, queries, and analysis hooks; the same-name `.mod` file holds the quad storage, stacks, metadata, and code that realize those operations.
